newsitem.title: ISRAEL: U.S. answers Saddam "aggressive behaviour" - envoy.
newsitem.headline: U.S. answers Saddam "aggressive behaviour" - envoy.

text.p: U.S. Ambassador to Israel Martin Indyk said the attack on Iraq on Tuesday was a response to Iraqi President Saddam Hussein's "aggressive behaviour".
After briefing Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy, Indyk told reporters: "We explained exactly why Saddam's aggressive behaviour needed to be responded to in a clear-cut manner."
Indyk said: "We updated him on the situation and he expressed his support for our actions and his understanding of the reasons why we had to take such action."
Indyk earlier briefed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on the U.S. attacks against air defence targets, carried out in retaliation for Iraqi attacks in the Kurdish north.
